subject: SIG v14 re-answers: non-breaking clarifications & delta summary
body:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme-corp.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: mark.reed@globex.io
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: SIG v14: new fields & request to re-answer

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the SIG upload. Our vendor intake team flagged SIG v14 because there are three new question clusters (multi-tenant isolation, ephemeral key rotation, and telemetry retention granularity) that are not directly mappable to the v12 answers we received.

Can Redwood provide: 1) a short delta summary that maps v12->v14 answer changes, 2) re-answers where the new fields change the original response, and 3) supporting evidence for the rotation and retention items (policy excerpts or controls screenshots). We prefer receiving re-answers in a tracked diff format or a CSV with question IDs + new answer.

Target: we need this in our FY-end intake by 2026-12-10. If you need more time, please propose an alternative date.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Sr. SecOps Manager, Acme Corp

---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG v14: new fields & request to re-answer

Elena — thanks for flagging this. We reviewed v14 and agree most of the changes are additive (non-breaking), but a handful of new prompts require updated text. Proposed plan:

- Today (12/02): Confirm scope and identify which question IDs will change.
- 12/03: Engineering & Risk produce a CSV with re-answers and a machine-readable diff (we'll attach a PDF diff).
- 12/04: Legal (Marissa) will do a quick review for any phrasing that affects contractual representations.
- 12/07: Deliver final re-answers + evidence bundle (policies/extracts/screenshots).

We can accelerate if Acme needs it sooner — Karthik, Vivek, Marissa: can you confirm availability for a quick sync this afternoon?

Attachments (first pass): sig-v14-diff.pdf (draft diff between v12 -> v14)

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG v14: new fields & request to re-answer

SG. I skimmed the diff and marked three items that might need careful language so we don't create a retroactive representation. High level:

- Q428 (ephemeral key rotation window): our internal policy is 7 days for service-to-service ephemeral keys; we should state the control as "rotation frequency configurable, default 7 days" rather than an absolute.
- Q511 (telemetry retention granularity): acceptable to provide retention ranges per telemetry class rather than exact TTLs.
- Q603 (tenant isolation descriptors): keep current answer but add a short paragraph calling out per-customer network segmentation for Dedicated/Private customers.

I can redline the CSV answers once Engineering posts the candidate re-answers.

-Marissa
Sr. Counsel, Compliance & Privacy
Redwood Inference

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG v14: new fields & request to re-answer

Quick update from infra: we can provide machine-diff and CSV by 12/03 EOD. Notes:

- "ephemeral_key_rotation_window": default = 7 days, supporting evidence: redwood-soc2-2025.pdf (section 3.2 shows automated rotation in our key manager).
- "telemetry_retention": we will supply a retention table (logs: 90 days default, metrics: 365 days default, traces: 30 days) and a note that Dedicated customers may configure longer retention.
- "tenant_isolation": we will confirm per-tenant network segmentation for Dedicated and Private, plus a screenshot of VPC isolation in the console.

Uploading: evidence-index.csv (mapping question IDs -> evidence files), sig-v14-diff.pdf (annotated).

Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Elena / Mark — forwarding the internal thread and attachments. Summary of deliverables attached:

1) sig-v14-diff.pdf — annotated draft mapping v12 -> v14 and the proposed re-answers.
2) evidence-index.csv — table mapping each question ID to the supporting evidence filename.
3) redwood-soc2-2025.pdf — excerpt showing key rotation control.

We expect to finalize re-answers after Marissa's legal pass tomorrow morning and will push the final CSV + PDF by 12/04. If Acme prefers tracked changes directly in the SIG PDF, we can provide that as well.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
